about: Every number this video shows or says. All of them are OURS: a worked example labeled EXAMPLE on screen (the missed calls, the jobs, the dollars), plus the lesson's own method (two weeks of counting, part 1 of 2). No outside study or percentage is used. The arithmetic is checked in code (jobs x clear = twoWeekValue; twoWeekValue x 2 = monthValue, said as 'call it' because a month is a little over four weeks).

example.source: OURS: an example two-week count, labeled EXAMPLE on screen; not a real shop or customer
example.monthNote: twoWeekValue x 2; said 'call it' because a month runs a little over four weeks
example.nextPartNote: Part 2 tries three options side by side: a missed-call text-back, a person answering, and an AI receptionist (research/topics-2026-10-30.md lesson 3).
example.rule: If the monthly price on the quote is bigger than what the missed jobs are worth a month, it can't pay for itself from missed calls yet.
